metformin_01.whatItIsFor: This medicine helps control the amount of sugar in your blood.
metformin_01.howToTake: Take one tablet twice a day. Always take it with your meals.
metformin_01.audioText: Metformin. This medicine helps control the amount of sugar in your blood. Take one tablet twice a day. Always take it with your meals.
mechanismSteps: You swallow the tablet and it enters your stomach.
It travels through your blood to your liver.
It tells your liver to make less sugar.
Your blood sugar level goes down and stays more steady.

salbutamol_01.whatItIsFor: This inhaler opens up your airways and helps you breathe more easily when you feel short of breath.
salbutamol_01.howToTake: Use 1 or 2 puffs when you need it. Shake the inhaler first. Do not use it more than 4 times in one day.
salbutamol_01.audioText: Salbutamol inhaler. This inhaler opens up your airways and helps you breathe more easily. Use 1 or 2 puffs when you need it. Shake the inhaler first. Do not use it more than 4 times in one day.
mechanismSteps: You press the inhaler and the medicine goes into your mouth.
You breathe it deep into your lungs.
It relaxes the tight muscles around your breathing tubes.
Your breathing tubes open wider and air flows in more easily.

betamethasone_01.whatItIsFor: This cream reduces redness, itching, and swelling on your skin.
betamethasone_01.howToTake: Apply a thin layer to the affected area of skin twice a day. Wash your hands before and after applying.
betamethasone_01.audioText: Betamethasone cream. This cream reduces redness, itching, and swelling on your skin. Apply a thin layer to the affected area twice a day. Wash your hands before and after applying.
mechanismSteps: You apply a thin layer of cream to the red or itchy skin.
The cream soaks into the top layers of your skin.
It reduces the chemicals in your skin that cause swelling and itching.
The redness and itch calm down over the next few hours.

amlodipine_01.whatItIsFor: This medicine helps lower your blood pressure and keeps your heart working smoothly.
amlodipine_01.howToTake: Take one tablet once a day. You can take it at any time of day but try to take it at the same time each day.
amlodipine_01.audioText: Amlodipine. This medicine helps lower your blood pressure. Take one tablet once a day, at the same time each day.
mechanismSteps: You swallow the tablet and it enters your bloodstream.
It travels to the walls of your blood vessels.
It relaxes and widens the blood vessel walls.
Your blood flows more easily and your blood pressure goes down.

prednisolone_01.whatItIsFor: This medicine calms down your immune system and reduces swelling and inflammation inside your body.
prednisolone_01.howToTake: Take the tablets as shown in your tapering schedule. Start with 4 tablets a day and reduce as instructed. Always take with food. Do not stop suddenly.
prednisolone_01.audioText: Prednisolone. This medicine calms down your immune system and reduces inflammation. Follow your tapering schedule carefully. Start with 4 tablets a day and reduce as instructed. Always take with food. Do not stop suddenly.
mechanismSteps: You swallow the tablet and it enters your bloodstream.
It travels throughout your whole body — not just one part.
It reduces the activity of your immune system, which is overreacting and causing swelling.
Swelling and pain go down — but do not stop taking it suddenly, your body needs to adjust slowly.

lisinopril_01.whatItIsFor: This medicine treats high blood pressure and helps your heart pump blood better.
lisinopril_01.howToTake: Take one tablet a day. You can take it with or without food.
lisinopril_01.audioText: Lisinopril. This medicine treats high blood pressure. Take one tablet a day.
mechanismSteps: You swallow the tablet and it enters your blood.
It stops a chemical in your lungs and kidneys from making blood vessels tight.
Your blood vessels relax and open up wide.
Your blood pressure drops and your heart works easier.

atorvastatin_01.whatItIsFor: This medicine lowers bad cholesterol in your blood to protect your heart.
atorvastatin_01.howToTake: Take one tablet daily, usually at night. You can take it with or without food.
atorvastatin_01.audioText: Atorvastatin. This medicine lowers bad cholesterol. Take one tablet daily at night.
mechanismSteps: You swallow the tablet and it goes to your liver.
It blocks the enzyme in your liver that makes cholesterol.
Your liver removes bad cholesterol from your blood.
Your arteries stay clear and your heart is protected.
